test_name: Audit and Accountability - AU-2 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Partner-Gateway-026
Primary NIST family: Audit and Accountability (AU); evidence focus: AU-2.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: the SOC reviews and correlates security audit records continuously with documented escalation rules. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
